protocol: Train labels only for fitting; validation-only configuration and mixture selection. Historical experiments have observed aggregate test scores, so this is not a blind evaluation history. No per-question test error analysis or peer weights/predictions.

selected.protocol: Final six-weight validation-only comparison; highest correct count then hard NLL within asset budget. No test access.

attention_selection.protocol: 5-fold stratified train-only networks with augmentation restricted within fitting folds. Validation selects epochs then mixture accuracy, ties by hard NLL. No test access.

tree_search.protocol: Five stratified question folds, seed 945; all linear and text evidence is train OOF. Binary trees fit only informative TRAIN groups. Six tree variants selected by validation correct, then hard NLL. No test access.

followup_protocol: The first candidate aggregate test score is known. Further model design uses train and validation only, with no per-question test analysis. Future results are not a blind evaluation history.

final_release.release_basis: User requested freezing the highest already-observed result and stopping further tuning. This returns to the first independently frozen candidate; the release choice was made after aggregate test scores were known and is not a blind test selection.
